title: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Catalog — GRCx Offline Baseline

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Apache Log4j2 Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Apache Log4j2 contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Apache Commons Text Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Apache Commons Text performs variable interpolation, allowing properties to be dynamically evaluated and expanded.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: OpenSSH ssh-agent Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: OpenSSH ssh-agent contains a remote code execution vulnerability in PKCS#11 provider loading.
The HTTP/2 protocol allows a denial of service (server resource consumption) because request cancellation can reset many streams quickly.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: OpenSSH Server (sshd) Signal Handler Race Condition Vulnerability (RegreSSHion)
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: A signal handler race condition in OpenSSH's server (sshd) allows unauthenticated remote code execution as root on glibc-based Linux systems.
